thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P1 — billing-metering-anomaly detected in prod-us-west. token_count delta vs shadow ledger > 5x over last 3m. Affected: billing-emitter. Runbook: /playbooks/billing-metering. INC: https://redwood/status/INC-185999

maya: ack, I'm taking lead. posting initial triage in thread.

ops-bot: metrics snapshot uploaded: https://graphs.redwood/prod-us-west/billing-emitter?range=5m (cpu/kafka/redis/token-rate)

maya: quick look — emitter throughput jumped ~6x, kafka consumer lag 0, redis INCR throughput spiked. looks like duplicate increments rather than real workload.

jon: i'm on redis. seeing burst of INCR on keys with prefix `billing:tokens:us-west:`. sample: `billing:tokens:usr_7f3a` jumped +1200 in 1m.

liz: any deploys or config changes in last 2h? could be a retry/regression in client SDK.

maya: no infra deploys recorded in last 2h (checked deploy-bot). billing-svc, do you see upstream retries or timeouts?

billing-svc: we see a spike in outgoing emitter requests and a corresponding rise in emitter ack timeouts (~504). clients retried aggressively. pausing background emitter and enabling fallback counter now.

ops-bot: executor: `POST /admin/pause_emitter` -> 200 OK. Applying edge ingress throttles for hot tenants: `rate-limit tenant=burst(50,10m)`

cs-team: we've got automated overage flags triggered for ~8 customers in the last 10m. please hold automated billing alerts until we reconcile — don't send invoices or billing emails.

maya: agreed — disabling auto overage notifications and creating manual CS queue. tagging affected customers in INC-185999.

jon: starting a reconcile job to diff shadow ledger vs emitted counts, will subtract duplicates. command: ```python tools/reconcile.py --since 1859990000 --mode=dedupe --write-fix```. preliminary estimate: ~92% of spike looks duplicated.

liz: also checking kafka — consumer offsets show normal progress, no duplicate delivery there. points to emitter acks/timeouts + client retries. we should consider adding a dedup id for next rollout.

billing-svc: root cause hypothesis: emitter ack timeout causing clients to retry without idempotency. Mitigations applied: paused emitter, throttled ingress, reconcile job started, suppressed automated overage alerts. CS to notify customers after reconcile.

maya: handing off to jon for overnight watch and postmortem. jon — can you own the incident ticket and customer comms? I'll update INC-185999 and the status page. :thumbsup:

jon: on it. reconcile progress: 30% done, ETA ~45m. will post updates here and file postmortem draft. switching pager to low-noise mode for watch.

incident-bot: Incident INC-185999 updated: state=mitigated -> monitoring. assigned_to=jon.
